title: Inbox reply result (P3, POST /inbox/items/:id/reply)
description: What answering an inbox item did (CR-4). `item` is the inbox item after the answer. `routed` is what happened to the record behind it; `restart` is what happened to the work (the agent run) behind it. `routed: already-decided` means another answer won the race: the item carries the winning answer and nothing was routed. Both are open sets: consumers must accept unknown values.

runId.description: The run now carrying the answer (steered = the same run, resumed = the new one).
